newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS in venture with Argentine ratings service.
newsitem.headline: CBRS in venture with Argentine ratings service.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday it has launched a new venture with Ratto-Humphreys Calificadora De Riesgo (R-H) of Argentina to serve the expanding South American capital markets.

CBRS said the partnership will provide both ratings and research for those investors purchasing Argentine debt issued on the international market. The bond rating service said the venture will also be a primary financial information resource to Canadian companies doing business in the Argentine market in specific and the South American market in general.

"The South American debt market is continuous growing, and our joint venture will provide the investors with CBRS's internationally accepted ratings and standards coupled with R-H's knowledge of the Argentine and South American economies," said CBRS president Brian Neysmith.
Buenos Aires-based Ratto-Humphreys, which has served the Argentine investment community since 1991, rates industrial, financial and government debt issues.
